summary: V38Q backend + frontend smoke: 12/12 backend pytest passed (business-card GET/PUT/upsert/public + qr_type validation + bill-draft auto-save to master_files + idempotency + regression: login, contacts DESC, master-files CRUD). Frontend Playwright smoke on /business-card: all 17 testIDs present (bc-back, bc-save, bc-name, bc-title, bc-company, bc-phone, bc-email, bc-website, bc-address, bc-tagline, bc-qr-type-{app|website|text|vcard}, bc-qr-content, bc-share-image, bc-share-link, bc-color-*), QR content field correctly hides for vcard and shows for website/text/app, save triggers, color swatch applies, share-link fires without exception. /master-files 'File' tab shows Carica file (cyan) + Foto (green) buttons; Foto opens bottom sheet with 4 correctly-colored options (violet/pink/cyan/green) matching spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py GET /master/business-card seed path returns a card object WITHOUT card_id when no doc exists yet. This is by design (the card_id is only generated on first PUT) but if the frontend attempts to share the public link before the user has ever saved, card_id will be undefined. The frontend business-card.tsx should auto-PUT once on first mount to guarantee a card_id, OR the seed handler should upsert a stub document. Non-blocking for V38Q — flag for consideration.

shareAsImage uses view-shot which is best-effort on web (html2canvas fallback). Smoke test confirmed shareLink flow works without exception; shareAsImage was NOT deeply verified on web preview per E1's note.
